title: Bulk Actions for Widgets | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Bulk Actions for Widgets Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000078437 A set of bulk actions is available for custom or brand-new widgets under Toolbox >> Widget Manager . These actions are not available for default widgets. The available bulk actions are Delete , Enable , and Disable : NOTE: Bulk Delete permanently removes the selected widgets and cannot be undone. If the goal is to deactivate widgets while keeping them available for future use, use Disable instead — see How To Disable a Widget . To perform a bulk action on widgets: 1. Select all widgets using the select-all checkbox shown below: Or select the widgets individually: 2. Select one of the available bulk actions and click Apply : 3. Once clicked, a confirmation pop-up will appear: 4. Once confirmed, the selected bulk action is applied to the selected widgets: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
